report.summary: (MOCK LLM, not a real model) Findings: 1 x lumpy skin disease.
immediate_actions: Isolate the animal from the rest of the herd and do not move animals on or off the farm.
Separate the animal from the herd and keep it away from other farms' animals
Do not move or sell animals; call your veterinarian or the animal-health authority at once: LSD is a reportable (notifiable) disease in most countries
Reduce biting flies, mosquitoes and ticks (they spread it): clean manure, remove standing water, use vet-approved repellents
Do not share needles, tools or water troughs between animals
Handle sick animals last and wash hands and boots afterwards

supportive_care: Treatment is supportive and decided by a vet (for example for secondary infections). Early reporting limits spread.

prevention: Buy animals only from known healthy herds and quarantine new arrivals
report.disclaimer: This is decision support based on visible signs in a photo, not a veterinary diagnosis. Confirm serious or notifiable conditions with a veterinarian or a laboratory test.
